details.description: Jamba 1.5 Large is AI21 Labs' largest Jamba 1.5 model, a hybrid SSM-Transformer (Joint Attention and Mamba) mixture-of-experts model with 94B active parameters out of 398B total, released August 22, 2024. It offers a 256K-token context window aimed at long-document processing, retrieval-augmented generation and enterprise agentic workflows, with built-in support for function calling, JSON-formatted output and document-based grounded generation with citations. AI21 has since released Jamba Large 1.7, and Hugging Face marks this 1.5 Large snapshot as superseded by that newer version.
advantages: AI21 reports an Arena Hard score of 65.4, which it states exceeds Llama 3.1 70B and 405B on that benchmark (AI21 launch post).
AI21 reports the 256K context window maintains 95.1% effective length at 128K tokens on the RULER long-context benchmark (Hugging Face model card).
Supports function calling, JSON-formatted structured output, and document-based grounded generation with citations for RAG workflows (Hugging Face model card).
AI21 reports up to 2.5x faster inference than leading models of comparable size in its own testing (AI21 launch post).
disadvantages: Hugging Face displays a banner marking this card superseded, pointing to a newer version, AI21-Jamba-Large-1.7 (Hugging Face model card).
Amazon Bedrock lists this model's lifecycle status as Legacy, with an end-of-life date of November 26, 2026 (Amazon Bedrock model card).
Knowledge cutoff of March 2024 (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Long-document summarization and analysis using the 256K-token context window
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with grounded, cited responses
Enterprise conversational AI and customer support
Agentic workflows using function calling and structured JSON output

sources.title: Jamba 1.5 Large - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (256000) is kept as authoritative per instructions, but Amazon Bedrock's own model card lists 'Max output tokens: 4K' for this model on Bedrock -- flagging the mismatch. Catalog's deprecation_date (2026-11-26) matches Amazon Bedrock's 'Model EOL date' exactly. A Hugging Face banner marks this specific 1.5 Large card superseded by AI21-Jamba-Large-1.7; a date given on that banner for a 'deprecation' (May 6, 2024) predates the model's own August 22, 2024 launch date and looks like a page-scraping artifact, so it was not used.
